chunks.text: Today, we will talk about France.
France is a beautiful and famous country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Where is France?
France is in Western Europe.
It is close to Germany, Italy, Spain, Belgium, and Switzerland.
To the west, it touches the Atlantic Ocean.
To the south, it touches the Mediterranean Sea.
France has mountains, beaches, rivers, and cities.
What is the capital city of France?
The capital city is Paris.
Paris is one of the most famous cities in the world.
Many people visit Paris every year.
Paris has the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, and the Seine River.
It is known for fashion, art, and cafes.
How many people live in France?
About 68 million people live in France.
Most people live in cities like Paris, Marseille, Lyon, Toulouse, and Nice.
But many people also live in villages and on farms.
France is a big country with different regions and cultures.
What language do people speak in France?
People speak French.
French is the official language.
It is spoken in schools, shops, and homes.
French is also spoken in other parts of the world.
It is an international language.
In big cities and tourist areas, many people speak some English.
What is the weather like in France?
The weather in France is different in different places.
In the north and west, the weather is mild and rainy.
In the south, the weather is warm and sunny, especially near the Mediterranean.
In the Alps, the mountains in the east, it is cold and snowy in winter.
People go there to ski.
Summer is usually warm and dry, especially in the countryside.
What does France look like?
France has many different landscapes.
There are mountains, rivers, beaches, forests, and fields.
The longest river is the Loire River.
The highest mountain is Mont Blanc in the Alps.
France also has beautiful coastlines, especially in the south, near Nice and Cannes.
What animals live in France?
In France, you can see many animals.
In the countryside, there are foxes, deer, rabbits, and wild boars.
In the mountains, there are ibex and marmots.
In the sea, you can see fish, dolphins, and seabirds.
France has many farms with cows, sheep, ducks, and chickens.
What do people eat in France?
French food is famous around the world.
People eat bread, cheese, meat, fish, and vegetables.
One common food is baguette, a long, thin bread.
Another is croissant, a soft, buttery pastry.
France has many kinds of cheese, like camembert and brie.
People also love wine, which comes from French vineyards.
Popular dishes include quiche, ratatouille, and beef bourguignon.
And, of course, desserts.
French desserts include crepe, tart, eclairs, and macarons.
What is life like in France?
Life in France is full of culture and tradition.
People enjoy food, family, and free time.
Many people like to sit at cafes, drink coffee, and talk.
Lunch is often long and relaxed.
In the countryside, life is peaceful.
In cities, life is busy, but full of things to see and do.
France has great schools, transportation, and health care.
People also enjoy music, art, theater, and fashion.
Some fun facts about France.
France is the most visited country in the world by tourists.
The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
France has over 1,000 types of cheese.
The Tour de France is a famous bicycle race.
The national motto is liberty, equality, fraternity.
The French flag is blue, white, and red.
Now you know many things about France.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what the weather is like.
You learned about the food, the cities, and daily life in France.
Great work.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
